title: 纳亚菲利 · 晒太阳的午觉
description: 红黑冥犬纳亚菲利蜷在暖垫上，身旁两只小伙伴也安静休息。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Naafiri retains her recognizable sleek canine body, pointed ears, charcoal coat, red markings, and distinctive metal blade-like ridges along her back. Render the ridges as smooth decorative shapes and her expression as sleepy and friendly, not frightening. Retain this champion's distinctive silhouette and recognizable accessories, softened into friendly rounded shapes with opaque clothing wherever appropriate.
art_direction.scene: She curls into a comfortable dog shape on a terracotta cushion beside a sunlit wall. Two much smaller canine companions rest nearby, separated clearly from her limbs, while a little water bowl catches one warm crayon highlight. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: charcoal, terracotta, coral red, pale gold, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
